skins.name: The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve
skins.code: Achievement Star Collection/The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve
skins.description: A "Destiny Quest" outfit made for Irene by the devs based on her role in the game. To promote the next update, she's forced to stand on the stage for a photo op.

skins.name: Terra & Traveller
skins.description: Clothes Marcille wears when telling stories of her adventures aboard Rhodes Island . She acts as she imagines the Lunatic Magician would, summoning several familiars with a wave of her hand. Some of them even look like our operators!

skins.name: The Apprentice and Her Aura
skins.code: Achievement Star Collection/The Apprentice and Her Aura
skins.description: Clothes Kroos wore when receiving an award at a game expo. She'd just cleared some quests with her friends when she was picked as the lucky player. Wearing the dev-provided costume, she smiled widely at the camera.
skins.image: /five-star-skins/Kroos the Keen Glint - The Apprentice and Her Aura.webp

skins.name: The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage
skins.code: Achievement Star Collection/The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage
skins.description: Clothes Leizi wore at a game expo. She plays a mysterious wandering scholar with a magical companion. Her dedication was praiseworthy, and she brought a true ending to the story.
